tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search articles using hybrid semantic and lexical search. Returns matching articles with title, snippet, and relevance score, best match first (higher score = more relevant).

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search apps using hybrid semantic and name-based search. Returns matching apps with name, category, rating, developer, and SGE coverage stats.

tools.name: get_similar_articles
tools.description: Find articles similar to a given article by slug. Uses semantic similarity to find related content.

tools.name: get_similar_apps
tools.description: Find apps similar to a given app by app store ID. Uses v2 embedding vector similarity for accurate results.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get the full content of an article by its slug. Returns title, content, categories, tags, and optionally related articles.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List recent articles with pagination support. Returns articles sorted by date (newest first).

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Browse apps with optional category filter and pagination. Returns apps sorted by most recently updated.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all article categories with their post counts. Useful for understanding the content structure.

tools.name: get_content_analytics
tools.description: Get content analytics including views and engagement metrics. Can analyze a specific article by slug or get top articles by reads.

tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Search social media videos across both SGE curated videos and app backcatalog videos. Supports hybrid semantic search by query, OR direct lookup by appStoreId (exact match, much faster). Returns matching videos with creator, hook type, pacing, view stats, outlier rate, duration, and source. English

tools.name: get_similar_videos
tools.description: Find videos similar to a given video by UUID. Searches across both SGE curated videos and app backcatalog videos using v2 embedding vector similarity to find semantically related videos by hook style, content, pacing, and visual approach. English videos by default; set language for other markets.

tools.name: hook_intelligence
tools.description: Analyze exact winning hooks, templates, formats, durations, and supporting evidence for an app, vertical, or broader market slice. For a niche, prefer scope_type "vertical" with a one-word scope_primary_vertical, or pass the topic in query (scope_label is display-only). English hooks by default; set

tools.name: hook_trends
tools.description: Compare current versus prior windows to find rising and declining exact hooks for an app, vertical, or market slice. Supports an optional semantic query to filter hooks by topic.

tools.name: strategy_compare
tools.description: Compare two app, vertical, or market scopes and surface differences in exact hooks, formats, durations, and evidence. Supports an optional semantic query to filter hooks by topic.

tools.name: app_strategy
tools.description: Run a deep strategy analysis for a single app from SGE apps_videos (viral-only sample). Returns rich hook/format/length insights and evidence.

tools.name: analyze_video
tools.description: Analyze a TikTok or Instagram video URL using Gemini vision and return similar viral videos from the SGE database (English by default; set language for other markets).

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate a full research report. Runs a deep search across ALL SGE data (articles, apps, videos) and creates a shareable report page. Returns the link to that page together with a short summary of what the report covers.

tools.name: trending_sounds
tools.description: Top TikTok sounds used in viral app-marketing videos over the last 14, 30 or 90 days, overall or for one niche. Use 14 days for what is trending now and 90 days for proven sounds in a niche (short windows have few sounds per niche). Each sound comes with its viral-video, creator and app counts, tota

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_categories · Private data: analyze_video · Public sink: get_categories · Destructive: app_strategy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_categories · Private data: analyze_video · Public sink: get_categories · Destructive: app_strategy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
